approach: Static recompilation of the EE code with PS2Recomp, a native renderer (Metal on macOS, OpenGL ES on PS Vita) fed at the game's own draw calls (models, skinning, lighting, fog, bloom, 2D), and a functional decompilation of the hot game code into native C++
notes: Runs on macOS and PS Vita through static recompilation. The PS2 hardware is being replaced step by step: the native renderer (SOTC_NATIVE=1) draws the game from its own model, texture and sprite data without the VIF/VU1/GS path, and the hot game code is being decompiled to native C++ for Vita speed (progress in docs/decomp_status.json).
